grading: Binary code-checked assertions over the skill's rendered plan. Every assertion is objectively decidable from the text — no judge, no scale. Criteria needing interpretation are listed under `deferred` and are deliberately NOT graded until a validated evaluator exists.

assertion_types.contains_all: every literal substring must be present
assertion_types.contains_none: no listed literal substring may be present
assertion_types.regex_any: at least one pattern must match (multiline)

shared_assertions.why: references/plan-template.md fixes the section order; a dropped header breaks the contract
Out-of-scope is what stops scope creep; a plan with only In is half a scope
Effort is a T-shirt size AND a 0-25 complexity score together; a bare digit anywhere in the text is not evidence either was given
The handoff is one ready-to-paste command line
Tests live inside each phase's scope, never as a phase of their own

evals.prompt: we keep getting duplicate push notifications on the macOS app when it wakes from sleep. help me plan a fix before i dive in.

assertions.why: A grounded plan must name the actual failure surface, not restate the request

deferred: Whether the Context section reflects THIS repo rather than a generic template — needs a validated judge.
